domain: cross-round adjudication -- resolves contradictions between prior rounds' findings via direct code-reading, not a semantic-distance lens
axioms: Adjudication does not invent new findings from a fresh domain lens; it re-verifies contested claims already in the ledger against the actual source, and reports which claim holds, which is an error, and what new-precision insight the correction itself exposes.
A verdict is reportable only when it changes the actionable content of the ledger: narrows an over-broad claim, corrects a mischaracterization, or surfaces a follow-on gap the correction reveals.
primitives: verdict-with-evidence: line-cited confirmation or refutation of a specific prior claim
narrowing-insight: what remains true and useful once an over-broad bundled claim is split into its correct and incorrect parts
failure_mode: Does not re-litigate settled, uncontested findings; only claims with a live tension (disagreement_refs or an internal bundling error) are in scope.
Does not introduce claims that were not already implied by the two sides of a documented contradiction.
